design.text: Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, multicenter study; patients randomized 2:1 to VOTRIENT 800 mg once daily or placebo once daily.

randomized (2:1) to receive VOTRIENT 800 mg once daily or placebo once daily.

population.text: Patients with locally advanced and/or metastatic RCC who had received either no prior therapy or one prior cytokine-based systemic therapy; all had clear cell or predominantly clear cell histology.

citations.quote: Patients (N = 435) with locally advanced and/or metastatic RCC who had received either no prior therapy or one prior cytokine-based systemic therapy were randomized (2:1) to receive VOTRIENT 800 mg once daily or placebo once daily.

endpoint.text: Progression-free survival (PFS) by independent radiological review was the primary endpoint; secondary endpoints included overall survival, overall response rate, and duration of response.

citations.quote: The primary objective of the study was to evaluate and compare the 2 treatment arms for progression-free survival (PFS); the secondary endpoints included overall survival (OS), overall response rate (RR), and duration of response.
The primary efficacy endpoint in Study VEG 10592 was progression free survival (PFS).

Patients (N = 435) with locally advanced and/or metastatic RCC who had received either no prior therapy or one prior cytokine-based systemic therapy were randomized (2:1) to receive VOTRIENT 800 mg once daily or placebo once daily.
435 subjects were randomized in a 2:1 ratio: 290 in the pazopanib arm and 145 in the placebo arm

result.text: Median PFS 9.2 months with VOTRIENT vs 4.2 months with placebo; HR 0.46 (95% CI 0.34, 0.62), P value <0.001. Response rate 30% vs 3%.

vote.text: The Oncologic Drugs Advisory Committee met October 5, 2009 and voted 10 to 0 that the benefit-to-risk profile was acceptable for treatment of patients with advanced RCC.

detail.text: The application was received December 19, 2008 and approved on the date of the approval letter for use in advanced renal cell carcinoma; no prior CRL is stated.

basis.text: The application received Standard Review priority designation.

citations.quote: Priority Designation	Standard Review

summary.text: VOTRIENT received regular (full) approval under a standard review for the treatment of patients with advanced renal cell carcinoma, based on a statistically significant improvement in progression-free survival in a placebo-controlled Phase 3 trial (VEG105192).

citations.quote: • Recommended Regulatory Action: Regular Approval
Priority Designation	Standard Review

The reviewers recommend regular approval of pazopanib at the proposed dosing schedule for the treatment of patients with advanced RCC. This is based on the findings of a robust improvement in progression-free survival (PFS) with pazopanib in a placebo-controlled study and of an acceptable safety profile for pazopanib as demonstrated in the submitted clinical studies of the product.
